data.long_meaning: Shabaj is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shabda' which means 'sound'. It also has the meaning of 'joy' and 'calmness'. The name is believed to bring light and happiness to one's life. The name Shabaj carries the meaning “Joy, Calmness, Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shabaj usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, calmness, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shabaj is a spiritual name that represents the sound of the universe. It is believed that by calling upon the name Shabaj, one can connect with the divine and find inner peace and joy.
